verdict.rationale: Skyfire is strictly an identity-and-payments rail (token issuance, KYA verification, charging, settlement) between buyer and seller agents; it has no order-management or fulfillment-tracking role. Order status/tracking after purchase is the seller's own system, not something Skyfire's token introspection (which only checks token validity/balance) addresses — this axis is a category error for a payments/identity infrastructure product.
